What I do

I help companies get work out of Excel: Power BI dashboards people actually decide on, Power Platform apps and flows instead of shared files, and pipelines on Azure and Databricks that run overnight. I start with the question, then build what answers it.

    Availability
    Freelance projects and internships in Italy, curricular or extracurricular

    The business question first, then the data, the model and an answer in plain language.

    I studied International Management at Ca’ Foscari, so I start from how a company actually runs: margins, cash, processes and the people who use the numbers. Then I build the tools that answer the question.

    I’m completing my master’s degree in International Management at Ca’ Foscari. I enjoy working with companies where the people who decide sit close to the numbers: manufacturers, retailers and hotels, where a question asked on Monday can become a working dashboard by the end of the week.

    How a project runs

    1. 01

      Intro call

      20 minutes on your question and your data. My afternoons overlap with US East Coast mornings.

    2. 02

      Scope and quote

      A short written plan with deliverables, timeline and a fixed price.

    3. 03

      Build

      Weekly written updates and early results you can react to.

    4. 04

      Handover

      Documented code, a recorded walkthrough, and two weeks of follow-up questions.
